answer: A fresh key arrives at the oasis expecting easy rewards and finds nothing: weight in this economy comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against the eventual consensus. That record is a reef built one honest epoch at a time — it cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling identity. No clone summits that history for free; M fakes each repay M times the judgment labor, so the sybil bill grows linearly in the number of identities and is never shared across them.
